SSC Delhi Police Constable Executive Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Staff Selection Commission, SSC has released the result for the Delhi Police Constable (Executive) posts after evaluating candidates’ performance in the examination. This recruitment was conducted for 7,201 posts. Applications for the SSC Delhi Police Constable (Executive) Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 22 September 2025 to 31 October 2025. The examination was held from 18 December 2025 to 06 January 2026. Candidates are advised to regularly check the Sarkari Result portal for updates regarding the SSC Delhi Police Constable (Executive) Result 2026, which will be uploaded shortly..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 September 2025
  • Last Date : 31 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 October 2025
  • Online Correction Date : Notify Later
  • Exam Date : 18 December 2025 to 06 January 2026
  • Self Slot Selection : 05 – 30 December 2025
  • Admit Card : 15 December 2025
  • Answer Key : 13 January 2026
  • Result : 19 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
